messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#769] Basic Question
parts:
Mapreduce takes an argument called backend parameters that can be used for parameters that are specific to each backend. This is a hadooop specific argument so it would go like backend.parameters = list(hadoop = list(D="mapred.reduce.tasks=120")). The use of this argument is deprecated and you will see a warning. The reason it was deprecated is that it's very easy to do very dangerous things with it. So in the future we will try to support some of the legitimate uses while closing the door to the abuses, that's the reason for the deprecation warning. This seems to be one of the legitimate uses. As far as the second problem you'll have to provide a bit more information for me to say much more than "sorry". It is certainly possible to use rmr2 both batch and interactively. Do you see any error message? Thanks


Antonio
